definitions: A thing that is granted, especially in response to demands; a thing conceded.
A preferential right or privilege granted by a government or other authority.
A reduction in the usual price of something, granted to a particular group of people.
A business or service operated within the premises of a larger business or venue.
examples: The government made several concessions to the protesters.
They were granted a concession to mine for minerals.
Students are eligible for a concession on public transport.
The cinema has a snack concession in the lobby.
